## UPSTREAM Commit Message Fix Required

This PR needs to reference the upstream fix per OpenShift conventions.

**Upstream Status:** ✅ Fix already merged in [kubernetes-csi/external-attacher#712](https://github.com/kubernetes-csi/external-attacher/pull/712) on 2026-04-14

**Required commit message:**
```
UPSTREAM: 712: Bump google.golang.org/grpc to v1.79.3

This update addresses CVE-2026-33186.

Related: OCPBUGS-80611
```

**Commands to fix:**
```bash
git checkout release-4.20_CVE-2026-33186
git commit --amend -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
UPSTREAM: 712: Bump google.golang.org/grpc to v1.79.3

This update addresses CVE-2026-33186.

Related: OCPBUGS-80611
EOF
)"
git push origin release-4.20_CVE-2026-33186 --force-with-lease
```

**Note:** PR #102 (release-4.21) also needs the same fix with OCPBUGS-80784.
